diff.description: Unified diff text; omitted when unavailable (untracked / over limit).

diff_truncated.description: True only when the diff was truncated; omitted otherwise.

path.description: Path relative to the project root.

seq.description: Per-run monotonic sequence for ordering inside a run. @since 0.15.0

source.description: Source of the change: write (LCS diff) or bash (numstat only). @since 0.15.0

tool_call_id.description: Tool call card this change belongs to; omitted when unavailable.

total_bytes.description: Original diff byte length when truncated. @since 0.15.0

FileChangeKind.description:
Change operation of a `FileChange`. `Unknown` tolerates forward values
(serde(other)); schema lists only the known values. @since 0.13.0

FileChangeSource.description: Source of a FileChange: write produces LCS diff, bash produces counts only. @since 0.15.0
